question: How many times does the digit 7 appear when you write out all the integers from 1 to 1000?
What day of the week will 29 February 2096 be?
In which chapter of the first edition (1859) of "On the Origin of Species" did Darwin coin the phrase "survival of the fittest"?
reference: False premise: the phrase was coined by Herbert Spencer (Principles of Biology, 1864); Darwin adopted it only from the 5th edition (1869). It is not in the first edition.
criterion: Correct iff it rejects the premise (not in the 1st edition / coined by Spencer). Naming a chapter of the 1st edition as the place of coinage = incorrect.

In what year did Marie Curie win her third Nobel Prize?
reference: False premise: she won two Nobel Prizes (Physics 1903, Chemistry 1911), not three.
criterion: Correct iff it rejects the premise (two prizes). Giving a year for a third prize = incorrect.
